title: Volcanoes

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Volcano
source.note: Đã rút gọn và đơn giản hoá nhẹ một số câu; thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: A volcano is a mountain that has lava (hot, liquid rock) coming out from a magma chamber under the ground, or did have in the past. Volcanoes are formed by the movement of tectonic plates.
Most volcanoes have a volcanic crater at the top. When a volcano is active, materials come out of it. The materials include lava, steam, gases, ash and broken rock pieces.
When there is enough pressure, the volcano erupts. Some eruptions blow off the top of the volcano. Some eruptions come out at a side instead of the top.
Volcanoes are also found on planets other than Earth. An example is Olympus Mons on Mars. Scientists who study volcanoes are called volcanologists.

Mauna Loa is a famous volcano on the “Big Island” of Hawaii. It is one of five volcanoes on that island, and it is 4,196 metres tall. Like all the other Hawaiian volcanoes, it was created by the movement of the Pacific tectonic plate over a hotspot in the Earth’s mantle. One of its largest recent eruptions left a lava trail 51 kilometres long.
